summary: Learn to design controlled finance AI workflows, reduce manual work, and improve reporting speed. Enroll in TrainingCred’s 5-day course.
lede: Agentic Automation for Finance and Back-Office teaches you to design and orchestrate governed AI workflows that retrieve data, route tasks, execute controlled actions, and escalate exceptions. You will learn to apply process mapping, control-point analysis, data validation, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop review to finance operations. The course helps you identify high-value automation opportunities and create practical implementation assets, including an opportunity map, control matrix, and rollout plan. You will also explore retrieval-augmented generation, API-driven task execution, and basic multi-agent orchestration in the context of reconciliation, reporting, approvals, payments, journals, master data, and compliance oversight.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who need to improve finance and back-office throughput without losing control, traceability, or compliance discipline.
prerequisites: Intermediate familiarity with finance or back-office processes such as accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger close, reconciliations, or shared-services operations is required. You should be comfortable reading process flows, basic control documentation, and KPI dashboards; no coding is required for completion, although experience with ERP reports, spreadsheet analysis, or workflow tools will help you participate more effectively. The course introduces agentic automation at an operational level, not as a software-engineering programme.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
